name: Addison McDowell
bio: a Representative from North Carolina; born in Whiteville, Columbus County, N.C., January 21, 1994; graduated from North Davidson High School, Lexington, N.C., 2012; B.A., University of North Carolina, Charlotte, N.C., 2016; staff, United States Representative Theodore Paul Budd of North Carolina, 2017-2019; professional consultant; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
